read.thesis: Canadian Solar's US cell capacity ramps to 2.1 GW Oct 1 and 6.3 GW in 2027, but Q2 net loss of $77M, 13.9% gross margin and -$181M operating cash flow show the capex cycle is still consuming cash; Q3 guide $1.3-1.5B revenue.

capex.quote: We anticipate full year 2026 CapEx to total around $1.3 billion. This implies higher capital outlays in the second half
